team.hero_subtitle: AutoGuildX is the community and marketplace for everyone passionate about cars, motorcycles, and all things mechanical — a home that matches your passion, whatever your level.
team.mission_title: Give automotive expertise the platform it deserves.
team.mission_body: Cars and motos deserve better than generic social networks and anonymous classifieds. AutoGuildX is built for everyone who lives and breathes this world — whether you fix them, build them, collect them, or just love them. A place where reputation is earned, skills are certified, and every connection is backed by identity and reviews.
team.value_enthusiasts_body: We are car and moto people first. Every feature is designed around how the community actually works — from weekend DIYers to full-time shop owners.
team.value_trust_body: Verified badges, honest reviews, and identity-linked profiles so you know exactly who you are dealing with.
team.value_community_body: Not an algorithm-driven feed. A network where expertise and reputation speak louder than ad spend.
team.value_knowledge_body: Courses and certifications from real experts — so skills and credentials stay within the community.

privacy.s1_auth: when you sign in with Google, Firebase Authentication (operated by Google) processes your Google account information. We receive only an authentication token.
privacy.s1_usage: IP addresses, browser type, and interaction logs collected automatically by Firebase and our hosting infrastructure for security and service reliability purposes.

privacy.s2_i7: To comply with applicable laws and legal obligations.

cookies_policy.title: Cookie Policy
cookies_policy.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how AutoGuildX ("we", "us", "our") uses browser storage technologies when you use our platform ("Service"). We are committed to being transparent about what we store, why we store it, and how you can control it.
cookies_policy.s1_body: Cookies are small text files that a website stores on your device when you visit it. They are widely used to make websites work efficiently, remember preferences, and provide information to site operators. Similar technologies — such as localStorage and sessionStorage — serve comparable functions but store data differently in your browser.
cookies_policy.s2_title: 2. What AutoGuildX Stores (and What We Don't)
cookies_policy.s2_intro: AutoGuildX does not use traditional HTTP cookies for tracking, advertising, or analytics. Instead, we use browser localStorage for a single, strictly necessary purpose:
cookies_policy.s2_row_purpose: Stores your JWT authentication token and user ID so you remain signed in between page loads and sessions.
cookies_policy.s2_row_duration: Until you sign out or clear browser data
cookies_policy.s2_no_session: Persistent session cookies from AutoGuildX itself
cookies_policy.s3_body_pre: When you sign in with Google, we use Firebase Authentication (a Google service). Firebase stores its own entries in your browser's localStorage and IndexedDB to manage your Google sign-in session. These entries are governed exclusively by
cookies_policy.s3_body_post: . AutoGuildX has no control over and does not access these entries directly.
cookies_policy.s4_body: The auth-storage key in localStorage is strictly necessary for the Service to function. Without it, you would be unable to remain signed in. Because this storage is essential, we do not require your prior consent to set it — however, you retain the right to remove it at any time by clearing your browser storage or signing out, which will end your authenticated session.
cookies_policy.s5_title: 5. How to Manage or Delete Browser Storage
cookies_policy.s5_intro: You can view, modify, or delete all browser storage at any time through your browser's developer tools or settings:
cookies_policy.s5_chrome: DevTools (F12) → Application → Storage → Local Storage, or Settings → Privacy and Security → Clear browsing data.
cookies_policy.s5_firefox: DevTools (F12) → Storage → Local Storage, or Settings → Privacy & Security → Clear Data.
cookies_policy.s5_safari: Develop → Show Web Inspector → Storage, or Settings → Privacy → Manage Website Data.
cookies_policy.s5_outro: Clearing AutoGuildX's storage will sign you out of the Service. Clearing Firebase's storage entries will also sign you out of your Google session on AutoGuildX.
cookies_policy.s6_body: Some browsers offer a "Do Not Track" (DNT) signal. Because AutoGuildX does not engage in cross-site tracking, the presence or absence of a DNT signal does not change the data we store.
cookies_policy.s7_body: We may update this Cookie Policy to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will update the "Last updated" date at the top of this page when we do so. Please review it periodically.
cookies_policy.s8_body: If you have questions about our use of browser storage, please contact us at privacy@autoguildx.com.
